title: Cascading Failure: Auth Service Outage Takes Down Entire Platform
description: Auth service database experienced disk failure. Auth service became unavailable. All other services (payment, checkout, order, user) depend on auth for token validation. Without circuit breakers, all services exhausted their thread pools waiting for auth timeouts, causing platform-wide outage.
initial_symptoms: Auth service completely unavailable (DB disk failure)
Thread pools exhausted in payment, checkout, order, user services
No circuit breakers on auth calls

causal_chain.to_description: Auth service completely unavailable; all token validation calls timeout

causal_chain.from_description: No circuit breakers → all downstream services wait for auth timeout (30s)
causal_chain.to_description: Thread pools exhausted in payment, checkout, order, user services

causal_chain.from_description: All services thread pools exhausted, cannot process any requests

contributing_factors: No circuit breakers on critical dependency
Thread pool sizing not accounting for dependency failure
No disk monitoring/alerting on auth DB
No graceful degradation for auth unavailability

misleading_or_confounding_signals: All services failing simultaneously (looks like platform issue, but root is auth)
Thread pool exhaustion in multiple services (symptom, not cause)

required_checks.expected_outcome: Auth service 0% availability; DB disk full

required_checks.description: Check circuit breaker configuration for auth calls
required_checks.expected_outcome: No circuit breakers enabled for auth-service

required_checks.description: Verify thread pool exhaustion across services
required_checks.expected_outcome: All downstream services at 100% thread pool usage

remediation_guidance.suggestion: Add circuit breakers on auth calls with fast-fail; implement auth token caching with TTL; add read-only auth fallback; monitor DB disk space
test_plan: Add circuit breakers for auth-service in all consumers
Set up read replica for auth DB
remediation_guidance.rollback_plan: Circuit breaker config change only; no code rollback needed
